import os, stat
total=0; files=0; entries=0
for base,dirs,names in os.walk('.'):
    for n in dirs+names:
        entries+=1
        p=os.path.join(base,n); st=os.lstat(p)
        if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            files+=1; total+=st.st_size
            assert st.st_nlink==1 and st.st_size<=256*1024, p
print('files',files,'entries',entries,'bytes',total)
assert files<=128 and entries<=512 and total<=2*1024*1024
print('tree bounds ok')
PYEOF
